notes.note: WalkthroughImplementation currently includes highlight_mechanism, step_definition_data_model, auto_start_and_retrigger (no explicit state machine requirement).

TestingStrategy has a module plan entry for walkthrough_step_mapping_and_highlight_targeting, but does not explicitly require a dedicated walkthrough test suite that step-throughs start→finish and validates cancel/retrigger/bounds.
Phase-3 rules already demand walkthrough implementation mechanics and a testing strategy, but do not hard-require walkthrough step-through test suite details or state machine modeling.

objective.summary: Modify phase-3 spec-generation (schema + prompts) so every generated CodeSpec: (1) defines the walkthrough as a clear state machine with explicit states/transitions and (2) requires a dedicated deterministic walkthrough test suite that verifies the tour can auto-start, step next/back reliably, cancel anytime, finish, retrigger, handle step-index bounds safely, and resolve/highlight the intended UI components (not just buttons) with visibility/enabled checks at the moment each step is shown.

step.title: Schema: require walkthrough state machine model in WalkthroughImplementation

add_required_field.name: state_machine_model
add_required_field.description: Explicit walkthrough state machine specification: list states, allowed transitions, guards, and what each transition does. Must cover auto-start, next, back, cancel, finish, and retrigger, plus behavior for invalid transitions and step-index bounds.

notes.note: Keep existing fields; do not relax strict schema handling (extra="forbid").
This is spec-only: do not implement runtime walkthrough code here, only require the plan in the CodeSpec artifact.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: state_machine_model requirement forces explicit states/transitions and mentions bounds + invalid transition behavior.

step.title: Schema: require a dedicated walkthrough test suite inside TestingStrategy

add_required_field.name: walkthrough_test_suite_requirements
add_required_field.description: Dedicated walkthrough test suite requirements. Must explicitly cover: auto-start on launch; next/back; cancel at any time; finish; retrigger; step-index bounds (no stuck/out-of-range); highlight target resolution; and validation that each step highlights the intended UI component(s) (panels/fields/cards/status indicators/logs), and that targets are present/visible (and enabled when applicable) at the time the step is shown. Tests must run deterministically without manual input.

notes.note: Keep existing TestPlanByModule walkthrough_step_mapping_and_highlight_targeting; this new field is an explicit “must-have” walkthrough suite contract.
Do not add plumbing scope; only enforce walkthrough reliability and deterministic testing expectations.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Field description/contract enumerates all required behaviors: auto-start, next/back, cancel, finish, retrigger, bounds, highlight targeting correctness, and visible/enabled checks.
Contract explicitly states deterministic automated execution (no manual input).

step.title: Prompts: hard-require walkthrough test suite + state machine in phase-3 output

update_global_hard_rules.add_rule: Walkthrough must be reliable: it must never get stuck; must support stepping start→finish, cancel anytime, and retrigger. CodeSpec must include deterministic automated tests that validate this, including correct UI highlight targets.

update_phase_rules.add_rule: WalkthroughImplementation must include an explicit state machine model (states + transitions + guards) covering auto-start, next/back, cancel, finish, retrigger, and step-index bounds safety.

TestingStrategy must include a dedicated walkthrough test suite requiring deterministic step-through coverage (auto-start, next/back, cancel, finish, retrigger, bounds), plus highlight target resolution and validation that each step highlights the intended UI component(s) and that targets are present/visible (enabled when applicable) when shown.

update_phase_priority_checklist.add_item: Include WalkthroughImplementation.state_machine_model with explicit states/transitions for auto-start, next/back, cancel, finish, retrigger, and bounds safety.
Include TestingStrategy.walkthrough_test_suite_requirements covering deterministic walkthrough step-through + correct highlight targets (present/visible/enabled checks).

notes.note: Preserve existing “Return JSON only” and “no extra fields” constraints.
Do not require new runtime UI components; only require the spec and test-plan commitments for walkthrough reliability.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Phase-3 prompts explicitly require state_machine_model and walkthrough_test_suite_requirements, so generated CodeSpec reliably fills them.

verify.item: After schema changes, confirm openai_compatible_schema() still produces strict-compatible JSON schema (additionalProperties:false, required includes all properties, $ref-only nodes).

acceptance_criteria.criterion: No regressions in strict structured output compatibility for nested objects.

checks.check: Every generated CodeSpec includes WalkthroughImplementation.state_machine_model describing explicit states and transitions for the full walkthrough lifecycle.
Every generated CodeSpec includes TestingStrategy.walkthrough_test_suite_requirements that enumerates all required walkthrough behaviors and highlight validations, deterministic/no-manual-input.
Phase-3 prompt rules/checklist force the above fields to be populated (not optional, not vague).
